versions.content: The function Gpt_DisableWakeup shall disable the wakeup interrupt of the referenced channel configured for wakeup. The function shall save an attribute like "wakeup disabled" of the channel. Comment: This attribute affects the wakeup interrupt always when the driver is in "sleep mode". In "normal mode" the attribute has no influence.
